note: Third validation layer. Each set is a complete, schema-valid, cross-referenced attempt. Closure is not validity: the same shared rule engine that evaluates the compact corpus is run over every set, and its derived status, reason codes, and diagnostics must reconcile exactly with the declared compile result. Same-attempt membership is proved by an explicit reference chain; reusable authority evidence (sources, policies, approvals, external evidence) is not attempt-bound but must be exactly referenced and content-addressed.
